label: PF Backlog 118
title: Dynamic knowledge/skill acquisition (learn what's missing)
body:
When the pipeline lacks domain expertise, research the net / open-source / blogs, compile knowledge, register skills, and use them. Wire core/domain_research.py + knowledge_compiler.py + skills_registry.py + skill_contracts.py + web_search (squad_manager).
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose this capability through the backend API with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store access/writes).

dashboard_impact.reason: What was learned + registered skills must be browsable (shares D7 with business-models-kb).
